description: This file contains bash functions related to diff comparison and sanitization, such as compare_diff_raw, compare_diff_raw_z, and compare_diff_patch, which process diff outputs for testing purposes.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw
methods.description: Compares two diff files after sanitization to ignore score numbers, indicating whether they are identical.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw_z
methods.description: Similar to compare_diff_raw but processes input differently for binary-safe comparison.

methods.name: compare_diff_patch
methods.description: Compares two patch files after filtering out non-essential lines like index and similarity index lines.
